g.title: Architecture
g.text: Part 5 complete: local agent over an extractive KB
The notebook runs the agent. Its model selects tools and writes the answer from the MCP evidence.
MCP uses the Search key. The model uses the OpenAI key. No KB model, hosted agent, Fabric or Work IQ.
Arrows: caller to dependency. Responses return on the same connection.
Blue, solid: local calls, MCP and evidence retrieval
Purple, solid: model call for tool selection / answer synthesis
Orange: configuration in this part. Faded: existing / background.
Logical lab architecture, not live status. Public endpoints, no VNet / private endpoints.
